messages:
Ava: Quick update — posted the compact pricing estimator A/B variant to /pricing as a soft launch at 11:00. It's behind a feature flag and wires up the new onboarding quiz flow. pls monitor inbound. :rocket:
Jon: Nice. Which variant did we put live, the single-slider one or the micro-quiz?
Ava: Micro-quiz. Wanted to see if contextual questions (team size + use case) drive higher CTAs than the slider.
Priya: Good call. We also swapped the tier names in this variant — switched from "Starter/Pro/Scale" to "Launch/Core/Enterprise" per brand workshop.
Marco: Heads up — Sales routing needs the lead payload change for the quiz results. Right now it only sends monthly usage estimate. Can we add recommended tier and a short rationale string?
Ava: Yup — payload update queued. @deploy-bot can you confirm the webhook schema was updated in staging?
deploy-bot: webhook-schema-update: staging -> success at 11:12 UTC. payload keys: quiz_score, est_tokens_month, recommended_tier, tier_rationale_url
Taylor: From CS POV, include a short note in the payload for "likely support needs" (SLA vs onboarding). Helps prioritize.
Jon: Quick benchmark idea — run a landing variant with the micro-quiz + a short benchmark blurb: "Save up to 3x on token costs with smart batching" and measure demo requests. We have latency/cost benchmarks ready.
Priya: I can draft the benchmark blurb and short explainer. Want it tight: 2 lines. Something like: "Real customers reduced token spend by 2.8x using Redwood Optimize settings for chat workloads."
Ava: Love it. Use a neutral phrasing and link to an appendix page for the full methodology. Don't call out specific customer names.
Marco: For webinar planning: can we do a quick "Pricing & Performance" 30-min session next Tues? Target PLG customers who've hit the 100K token threshold. We'll use the estimator funnel as the hook.
Taylor: Count me in for the live QA. Also suggest a 5-min demo of the quiz -> routing -> sales handoff.
Jon: I'll put a registration page in Marketo and wire the funnel to the inbound routing rule that labels leads as "estimator_trial". Marco, confirm preferred follow-up cadence (email + AE outreach?).
Marco: 24h follow-up email + AE touch for leads with est_tokens_month > 200k. Otherwise nurture sequence.
Ava: UX note — some users said the quiz felt like too many steps in testing. We shortened to 3 questions and added progress microcopy. Deployed in variant B.
Priya: Also edited the FAQ snippet under the estimator to add: "How accurate is the estimate?" -> "Estimates are based on your inputs and historical workload patterns; we recommend contacting sales for contract sizing."
Jon: Can we add a small inline CTA in the FAQ: `Have an unusual workload? Book 15 mins` — links to scheduler. That tends to convert better.
Taylor: For inbound tagging: include `estimator_variant: microquiz` and `tier_suggestion` in the lead metadata. Helps reporting.
Ava: Results to monitor over next 72h: estimator conversion (click -> contact), demo signups, bounce on first question, and FAQ CTR. I'll share dashboards.
Priya: I'll write the benchmark narrative and drop in the appendix doc. ETA EOD today.
Marco: I'll update the AE playbook with the new rationale string examples and the follow-up script. ETA tomorrow morning.
Jon: Small experiment suggestion — for 50% of micro-quiz users show tier names as "Launch / Growth / Enterprise" and 50% show the numeric usage bands (e.g., "<50k / 50k–250k / 250k+") to see which reduces confusion. A/B will be via feature flag.
Ava: Good idea. Let's keep the main copy stable but swap the label rendering only. Add feature-flag `pricing_tier_label_test`.
Priya: Noted. Will add to the list of variants.
Taylor: FYI, support thread opened by a tester: "Estimator recommended wrong tier for heavy embedding use" — just flagging because the quiz logic assumes text-gen. We should add a clarifier question about embeddings.
Ava: Good catch. I'll add a conditional follow-up question when they choose "embeddings" as a use case.
Jon: Tracking: event `estimator_submitted`, property `quiz_flow_version`, `recommended_tier`, `treatment_flag`. Need these in analytics.
Ava: Logged. tagging analytics to dash.
Priya: Draft of benchmark blurb posted: https://redwood.design/appendix/estimator-benchmark (will replace with canonical link). Feedback welcome.
Marco: Looks good — can we add a single-line ROI example? e.g., "A customer with 200M monthly tokens reduced spend from $X to $Y" but scrub numbers for now.
Ava: Keep anonymized; maybe use percentage instead: "~65% cost reduction on prefixes and caching".
Jon: Final ask — capture a sample lead JSON in the doc so we don't mismatch keys. Example in thread: ```{
  "email": "lead@example.com",
  "est_tokens_month": 220000,
  "recommended_tier": "Growth",
  "tier_rationale": "high concurrency, short chat sessions",
  "estimator_variant": "microquiz_v1"
}```
Taylor: Perfect. I'll run a quick QA on the webhook and confirm with Sales that fields parse.
Ava: Thanks team — will report back tomorrow with early numbers. :eyes:
